services.name: Parasail Flight
services.desc: Flight: Platinum Flight includes 1200' of towline and a "Free Fall" where the captain slows down the boat and lets you drift down toward the water, then accelerates to bring you on an "Elevator Ride" back to the top as well as a dip if you like. The boat ride is a thrill in itself as we often see dolphins, manatees and plenty of birds on our trips. Premium Flight includes 800' of towline. Duration 1 Hour Observer: Whenever we have room on the boat, observers are welcome to come along for the ride.
